note: 0.3.0 player-owned shops. One empty building per town (data/towns/*.json, kind "player"); only the player can buy it (a coin sink). 8 display stands; a stand holds one item id: gear/tools up to gear_cap, anything else up to stack_cap. Sales go to the till minus the Exchange tax (2 % on sales of 50+ marks, TownMarket.tax_on). AI buy from it at their normal trading cadence (AIBrain.trade / trader buy_quote), only for things they need (or bargains of things they keep), capped by budget and per-agent daily lots. Chance per look = base x deal^deal_exp x attractiveness, deal = min(best local alternative, reference x alt_cap) / your price. Priced above the alternative: x pricey_mult. Above reference x max_ref_mult: never.

attract.note: attractiveness = base + fill x stocked-stand share + variety x distinct-items share + demand x share of stocked items this town traded yesterday + decor (hook for future furniture, 0 now). Range about 0.6 - 1.4.
